scripts.dev: npm run build:all && wrangler pages dev ./dist --compatibility-date=2024-09-23 --port 8788
scripts.dev:full: concurrently "npm run build:all && wrangler pages dev ./dist --compatibility-date=2024-09-23 --port 8788" "echo 'Dev server started'"
scripts.build:all: npm run build:worker && mkdir -p dist && cp -r public/. dist/
scripts.deploy: npm run build:all && wrangler pages deploy dist --project-name=golf-score
